title: NHANES Health Insights
text:
The National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) assesses the health and nutritional status of adults and children across the United States.










Key Observations

Young Adulthood: Obesity rates start around 20–30% in early adulthood for both males and females.
Middle Adulthood: Obesity prevalence rises through midlife, peaking near 40–45% between ages 45 and 65.
Older Age: Obesity rates decline in later decades, likely reflecting both metabolic shifts and survivorship effects.
